routes.request: Create or review a resume or application packet
routes.target: Riley Morgan · AI orchestrator → Priya Desai · Job search orchestrator → Evidence-led Job Search Playbook
first_reads: Riley Morgan default routing contract when the request is unqualified; explicit specialist or Skill requests route directly
docs/playbooks/evidence-led-job-search.md: Routine application preparation is the default; load only relevant detail for exceptions
docs/job-search/application-context-and-review.md for context reuse and final-review criteria
scripts/application-packet.mjs for routine native Google Docs copy/edit/export/save and reviewed Applications recording; load once per batch with private inputs/checkpoint

one active private Candidate Application Context, its applicable Operating Pack, standing decisions, designated Candidate Baseline Resume and relevant evidence; read once per batch and carry source references/revisions
current employer posting and application requirements for each role
docs/job-search/application-tracker-contract.md and the existing private tracker record when opportunity/application tracking is in scope
Template catalog and verified rickvang/template-library source/revision only for outputs actually created; reuse unchanged verification within the batch
docs/job-search/application-work-order-template.md only when unique execution/recovery state warrants a detailed Work Order
docs/job-search/job-ledger-contract.md only when repeated discovery/deduplication is in scope
candidate-context-integration.md or resume-template-mapping.md only when candidate boundaries, precedence or a new semantic mapping need resolution
non_triggers: Uploading, submitting, contacting an employer, or externally sharing without a separate explicit request
Claiming provider-specific rules without current evidence
Treating Riley Morgan as the Job Search Persona or sole domain expert
Storing private job-search history inside Persona-Library
Treating the Playbook itself as the actor or domain owner
Treating a full application packet as one combined document instead of separate role-folder artifacts
Using a private Drive master as the canonical reusable Template when template-library has not been checked and verified
Mixing evidence, standing decisions, voice rules, contact details, or validation overlays from different candidate contexts
Skipping a standing-decision-designated Candidate Baseline Resume or substituting a secondary profile store without an explicit supported disposition
routes.next_handoff: Riley Morgan routes unqualified narrow work to the smallest relevant specialist or Skill and full-outcome work to Priya Desai, who operates the Evidence-led Job Search Playbook. Explicit specialist, Skill or Playbook requests route directly. The Playbook owns stages, shared state, handoffs, quality gates, recovery and the learning loop. For packets, start with its Routine application preparation path: resolve one private Candidate Context and standing decisions, read the designated Candidate Baseline Resume and relevant evidence once per batch, record source revisions and preserve the career spine; secondary profile stores cannot replace an unresolved baseline. Read each current employer posting and required form questions. Create the private resume and a separate cover letter only when needed; keep brief answers, source references, unknowns and next action in the existing tracker. A separate notes document and detailed Work Order are conditional on substantial content or unique recovery needs. Verify only Templates for outputs being created and reuse unchanged context until a source, instruction, revision or tool-required freshness boundary changes. Review the actual final submission revision once against factual integrity, ATS/readability, candidate rules, employer requirements, candidate isolation, extraction, links and rendered-page quality; reopen only checks affected by corrections. Complex forms, material source conflicts, new layouts, second renderings or requested independent review add only the necessary exception steps. Resolve an existing tracker record before creating a duplicate; preserve sourceUrl, known postingDate and later confirmed lifecycle states. Record packetUrl and Packet Ready only when required answers and artifacts pass review; unresolved material facts remain Reviewing. Applied/appliedDate require confirmed submission; interview, offer and closure states require confirmed events. Preparation does not authorize submission, outreach or sharing.
